description:
Live availability and exact prices at Landhaus Apartments Prägant (Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria).

Applies the booking rules (arrival days, minimum stay, closures). Returns the free apartments with the
total price split into stay, final cleaning and tourist tax, the payment and cancellation terms, matching
website offers and a booking link per apartment. If the wish is not bookable it returns the nearest
bookable alternative dates with prices; parties larger than one apartment get a combination of apartments.
Ask for dates, adults and children's ages first. To SHOW the result as a card call
render_availability_card with the same arguments.

adults.description: TOTAL adults (18+) of the whole party — also for groups larger than one apartment; the tool plans the apartments
adults.title: Adults

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0–17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'. Empty if none. Ages matter for price and tourist tax.
children.title: Children

language.description: 'de' (default) or 'en' — the language of the conversation
language.title: Language
